fields.name: recipient_name
fields.description: Name of the individual who received the diploma/certification.

fields.name: institution_name
fields.description: Name of the school, college, or certifying authority.

fields.name: credential_title
examples: Bachelor of Arts in English Literature
fields.description: Degree, diploma, or certificate title awarded.

fields.name: date_awarded
fields.description: Date the credential was officially conferred.

fields.name: program_duration
fields.description: Duration or length of study (if applicable).

fields.name: certificate_id_number
fields.description: A unique reference number sometimes included on the diploma.

fields.name: honors_or_distinctions
fields.description: Any honors or special recognition noted on the credential.

fields.name: official_signatures
examples: Dean of the College, Board Chair
fields.description: Authorized signatures or stamps that validate the diploma.

document.document_description: A diploma or certification is an official credential awarded by an educational institution or certifying body upon completion of a degree program, course, or specialized training. They confirm the recipient’s qualification or academic achievement.
